<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex8602_202409182" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon">

        <lb edRef="inst:5282" n="95a7"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5283"><choice><reg>rnaM</reg><orig>°M</orig></choice> bshad</rs> 'di ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">tshig nyung dus gzhung gi don rgyas par <expan>rtogs</expan> par 'dod pa</rs> <expan>dag gis</expan> yang dang yang du bskul nas ¦ <choice><reg>sdom</reg><orig>d°oM</orig></choice> brtson daM pa mkhas pa'i <expan>mchog grub</expan> pa mnyes <expan>pa'i</expan> skyes bu <expan>chen po</expan> || snyan po dra gsung <expan>phyogs</expan> bcur <choice><orig><note type="gloss">'</note>phro</orig><reg>'phros</reg></choice> pa ¦ rnam par dag cing lhun gyis grub pa'i <expan>'phrin las</expan> kyis <choice><reg>bskal</reg><orig>°skal</orig></choice> pa dang ldan pa <choice><reg>rnams</reg><orig>rnaMms</orig></choice> kyi <expan>rnam par</expan> 'dren pa | <choice><orig>mtshangs</orig><reg>mtshungs</reg></choice> pa med pa ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4052">yang dag <expan>pa'i</expan> dge ba'i <expan>bshes gnyen</expan> <expan>smon lam</expan></rs> gyi mtshan <lb edRef="inst:5282" n="95a8"/> daM pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos yang dag par len pa ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6029">shAkya'i dge slong <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> ston dpal bzang po</rs>s <choice><reg>sbyar</reg><orig>°byar</orig></choice> ba || <expan>rdzogs so</expan> || </seg></TEI>
